# Universal Converter

> Convert images, documents, video and audio, build PDFs and pull tables into Excel on your own device. Free, no ads, no account, and your files are never uploaded.

Universal Converter is a free-to-use desktop and mobile app by Christos Tzouvaras for Windows 10 and 11 (also in the Microsoft Store), Mac with Apple silicon and Android 10 or newer. Everything runs on the user's own device: files are never uploaded, it works offline, and it has no ads, no account and no watermark.

## What it does
- Documents & PDF: Convert between PDF, Word, ODT, RTF, TXT, Markdown, HTML, EPUB, PowerPoint and Excel. Turn pages into images and combine several files into one PDF. Fonts, sizes and colours are kept. Make PDFs smaller, to the size you choose.
- Images: Convert between JPG, PNG, WEBP, TIFF, BMP, GIF and ICO. Resize by pixels, percent or file size, combine pictures into a PDF or Word file, and read the text in pictures (OCR). PDFs can be added too: every page becomes a picture.
- Video: Convert videos between MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV and AVI, and compress them, with AV1, H.265, H.264 or VP9. Trim, crop, rotate and resize, make GIFs, save frames as pictures, or keep just the sound as MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV, OGG or Opus. On Android: MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV or GIF, or the sound as M4A, OGG or WAV; trim, crop, rotate, resize and save frames.
- To Excel: Pull tables out of PDFs, scans and photos into Excel or CSV: bank statements, invoices, price lists. Reads Greek, English, Spanish and more than 30 other languages.
- Sign: Sign PDFs and fill in forms. Type your name in a handwriting style, draw your signature or use a photo of it. The app finds the signature lines by itself, or you click or tap where the signature, initials, date, text or ticks go. Sign many files at once; the originals stay untouched.
- Uses your graphics card for video when it can: usually 5 to 20 times faster.
- Drag in whole folders: every file is converted in one go.
- Tells you when a file belongs in another tab, and takes it there with one click.
- Tells you about new versions; on Windows and Mac it can install them for you, digitally verified.
- Light and dark look, to match your device.

Interface languages (18 languages): English, Greek, Spanish, Italian, German, French, Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Arabic, Hebrew, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Tamil, Afrikaans, Yoruba and Hausa.

## How-to pages
- [Convert a PDF to Word](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/pdf-to-word.html): Turn PDFs into editable Word documents on your own device, keeping fonts, sizes and colours.
- [Convert Word documents to PDF](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/word-to-pdf.html): Turn Word, ODT, RTF and text files into PDF on your own device, keeping fonts, sizes and colours, for free.
- [Combine several files into one PDF](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/merge-pdf.html): Merge PDFs, Word, PowerPoint and other documents into a single PDF, without uploading anything.
- [Compress a PDF to a size you choose](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/compress-pdf.html): Make a PDF smaller - for example under 500 KB or 2 MB for an email or an upload form - without uploading it anywhere.
- [Convert PDF pages to JPG images](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/pdf-to-jpg.html): Save every page of a PDF as a JPG or PNG picture, for slides, websites and messages, free and offline.
- [Turn a scanned document into an editable Word file](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/scan-to-word.html): Convert scanned pages, photos of documents and image-only PDFs into editable Word files with text recognition (OCR), offline.
- [Convert pictures between JPG, PNG, WEBP and more](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/webp-to-jpg.html): Turn WEBP pictures from the web into JPG or PNG, or the other way round, for free and offline.
- [Resize pictures or shrink them to a file size](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/resize-image.html): Make photos smaller by pixels, by percent or to a target file size, such as under 1 MB for a form.
- [Combine photos into one PDF](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/images-to-pdf.html): Put JPG, PNG and other pictures into a single PDF, in the order you choose, offline and for free.
- [Copy the text from a picture (OCR)](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/image-to-text.html): Read the text in photos, screenshots and scans and save it as text or Word, offline. Greek, English and many more languages.
- [Compress a video without uploading it](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/compress-video.html): Make videos smaller on your own device, for free: choose the quality, keep the resolution or shrink it, and use your device's hardware for speed.
- [Convert videos between MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV and AVI](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/video-to-mp4.html): Convert almost any video to MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV or AVI: free, offline, with no size limit.
- [Save the sound of a video as MP3](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/video-to-mp3.html): Extract the audio from videos as MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV, OGG or Opus on your own device.
- [Make a GIF from a video](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/video-to-gif.html): Turn a moment of a video into an animated GIF or WebP, offline and for free.
- [Pull tables from a PDF into Excel](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/pdf-to-excel.html): Turn bank statements, invoices and price lists in PDFs, scans or photos into Excel or CSV, on your own device.
- [Convert a bank statement PDF to Excel](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/bank-statement-to-excel.html): Turn PDF bank statements, including scanned ones, into Excel or CSV for budgeting, bookkeeping and taxes, privately on your own device.
- [Extract tables from PDF invoices into Excel](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/invoice-to-excel.html): Pull line items, quantities and prices from PDF and scanned invoices into Excel or CSV, many files at once, offline.
- [Sign a PDF](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/sign-pdf.html): Add your signature, initials and the date to PDFs on your own device: type, draw or use a picture of your signature.
- [Fill in a PDF form](https://christzouv.github.io/universal-converter/fill-pdf-form.html): Type into PDF forms, tick boxes and add text, the date and your signature anywhere on the page, then save it as a finished PDF.
